title: Jesus, Did God Already Choose My Wife Like He Made Eve?

bible.text: He who finds a wife finds what is good and receives favor from the LORD.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... since You made Eve from Adam's rib, does that mean You've already chosen one specific woman for me too?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: That first marriage was one act, for one man and woman, at the beginning of everything. Every marriage since has been formed a different way -- through choice, character, and faithfulness.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: So there's no thread already tying me to her? Then how do I even recognize her?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Not by fate, but by fruit. Watch how she loves, how she treats others, how she seeks Me. That's a truer sign than any bone or rib.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Do you believe marriage is destiny, or something you build with wisdom?
